name: Grilled meat in steamed rice sheets
nameVi: Thịt xiên nướng cuốn bánh ướt
summary: The 16 Apr 2024 city page calls this a familiar Da Nang plate: hot grilled meat rolled in bánh ướt with herbs from Trà Quế, green banana, and cucumber, then a sauce the page does not name beyond calling it special.
origin: Da Nang, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. The herbs are from Trà Quế. A street was not printed.
taste: The page names a sweet sauce, fragrant meat, chili heat, and the astringent bite of the herbs.
howToEat: Roll the meat, still hot off the charcoal, in a steamed rice sheet with the herbs, green banana, and cucumber, then use the sauce.
where: The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street. Check on arrival. Trà Quế is the herb village it names, in Hội An, not a Da Nang door for the meat.
seoTitle: Grilled meat in banh uot — a Da Nang plate
seoDescription: Da Nang rolls hot grilled meat in bánh ướt with Trà Quế herbs, green banana, and cucumber. The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street. Check on arrival.
